_note: Near-term dated claims from the August 2026 videos, including the '2027 the eye of the hurricane' forecast. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: The four horsemen sequence runs famine and then further plagues, but this year is a window of reprieve lasting through the second half of it.
mentions.quote: I'm giving you a window of reprieve
mentions.time_phrase: the last half of this year
mentions.falsify_match: Conditions stay benign through the end of 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: A major dislocation lands before 2027, which he says would prove the word wrong.

mentions.claim_text: A new oil boom arrives with a new method of pumping oil out of the ground, across southern Colorado, Alaska, Kansas, the Texas panhandle and Oklahoma.
mentions.quote: I saw a new oil boom. I saw a new way to gather oil
mentions.falsify_match: A US production boom driven by a new extraction technique in those states.
mentions.falsify_miss: No new technique and no production surge there.

mentions.claim_text: Oil pipelines and the Canadian economy are in trouble, with a shaking of the economy, while JD Vance takes a larger role and reaches across the aisle to Democrats.
mentions.quote: Canada economy is in trouble and I saw a shaking of the economy
mentions.falsify_match: Canadian recession plus a Vance-led bipartisan turn.

mentions.claim_text: A shaking in New York involving Mamdani and the five families in 2027, with an uprising of people and court battles reaching the Supreme Court over things ruled unconstitutional.
mentions.quote: I saw a shaking in New York with Mandami and the five families in 2027
mentions.falsify_match: A New York political crisis with major litigation in 2027.

mentions.claim_text: Social Security is in trouble and a plan is brought forward to fix it, framed alongside what they will call a new golden age going into 2027.
mentions.quote: I saw social security was in trouble
mentions.falsify_match: A Social Security funding crisis and a legislative rescue plan.
mentions.falsify_miss: No crisis and no plan in that window.

mentions.claim_text: A plan removing property tax for seniors who own their homes outright, described as a stimulus aimed at boomers losing homes to the government.
mentions.quote: no longer have to pay property taxes on your home because you're a senior citizen
mentions.falsify_match: A federal or state property tax exemption for seniors is proposed.

mentions.claim_text: The second term becomes a stalemate presidency that cannot get anything past the Senate through 2027 and 2028, so legislation must be pushed through quickly now.
mentions.quote: a stalemate presidency will be at the second term
mentions.falsify_miss: The administration passes major legislation in that period.

mentions.claim_text: 2027 will be heaven on earth if it is prayed into, because of the new golden age, while 2028 has the potential not to be good.
mentions.quote: 2027 will be a heaven on earth if you pray into this
mentions.falsify_match: A strong 2027 followed by a weak 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable as framed: a bad 2027 is attributable to insufficient prayer.

mentions.claim_text: A virus they intend to bring out in October, November or December, which he says can be lessened by prayer.
mentions.quote: you pray against this virus concerning what they want to do October, November, December
mentions.falsify_match: A new outbreak or pandemic declaration in Q4 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Q4 2026 passes with no new outbreak, though he pre-attributes that to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: This is a seventh year and a short window of reprieve and preparation, while they will try to call it a digital golden age and pump the economy for 2028.
mentions.quote: it's a digital golden age trying to pump the economy for 2028
mentions.falsify_match: A stimulus-driven boom marketed as a golden age into 2028.

mentions.claim_text: A cashless society is rolled out across 2027, 2028, 2029 and 2030, in which everyone is known and tax fraud becomes impossible.
mentions.quote: they're going to roll this out in 2027, 2028, 2029, 2030
mentions.falsify_match: Physical cash is retired in favour of a fully traceable system by 2030.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cash remains legal tender and widely used in 2030.

mentions.claim_text: Birthing pains double after Rosh Hashanah, with major earthquakes, and the world will be unrecognisable by this time next year going into the fall of 2027.
mentions.quote: You will not recognize the world by this time next year
mentions.falsify_match: A visible step change in global disruption within that window.
mentions.falsify_miss: The period passes as an ordinary year.

mentions.claim_text: A cyber attack puts a computer virus into American systems and takes the grid down for up to three weeks, which he links to hackers taking British power plants offline for four days.
mentions.quote: last up to three weeks by some kind of putting a virus in the computers
mentions.severity: up to three weeks without power
mentions.falsify_match: A cyber attack causing a multi-week US grid outage.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a Bill Gates warning about an AI-driven bioterror pandemic and job losses as confirmation of what he was shown about the fall of 2027.
mentions.quote: the Lord warned us about 2027 the fall of 2027
mentions.falsify_match: A pandemic or bio event in autumn 2027.

mentions.claim_text: He allows that the rapture could come by 2028, while saying he hopes the church is not present for what he saw.
mentions.quote: we could see that rapture of the church within by 2028
